highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and moves the bundled engine through Skia m152 and m153.
highlights_body: It adds a Vulkan.Silk.NET package and backend-neutral async pixel reads, restores Nano Server font support, and fixes several native use-after-free and resource-leak bugs.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before falling back to the previous FcFontSort path on Linux. Applications that depend on the exact fallback face may see different text metrics or glyphs after upgrading; use an explicit family/style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through m152 and m153
bullets.detail: Brings the bundled Skia engine through the m152 release line and its Chrome servicing fixes, up to milestone m153, including upstream bug-fix merges along the way.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works across GPU backends.
Ships the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET to create Vulkan contexts.

Fixes native use-after-free crashes by keeping an SKRegion alive for its SpanIterator and rooting the pixel source of SKPixmap derived views. It also closes leaks in HarfBuzz blob conversion, failed raster-image creation, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset().
Uses FreeType for font support on Nano Server.

Removes a defensive Feature[] copy in HarfBuzz Font.Shape, avoids char boxing in SKFourByteTag/Tag.ToString, caches a reflection-based skip-registration check, avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText's null-terminated path.
Produces symbol packages with native dSYMs for macOS, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and tvOS, improving native debugging without changing the runtime packages.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Restored Nano Server font support by switching it to FreeType.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed the Windows native build to initialize the MSVC environment only once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 added the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel reads, and fixed several native memory leaks found during an audit.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 bumped to Skia m152, restored Vulkan.Silk.NET package production, added Apple native symbol packages, and fixed additional resource leaks.

harfbuzz_summary: Avoids a defensive Feature array copy in Font.Shape for lower per-call overhead.
